Barclays to Cut 5,000 Jobs as AI Starts to Create Efficiency
general.summary: Barclays Plc said it’s cutting 5,000 jobs as part of an effort to reduce costs, adding that artificial intelligence is starting to create efficiency. Bloomberg's Charlie Wells breaks down the situation. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Huawei Gets $2.3 Billion Offshore Loan as Chip Spending Soars
general.summary: Huawei Technologies Co. has secured a 15 billion yuan ($2.25 billion) loan from Chinese banks, according to a person familiar with the matter, as spending on chips to power artificial intelligence related projects soars.

general.title: Malaysian Traffic App Draws Ridicule After Officials Banned Waze
general.summary: Malaysia’s government-backed navigation app TuJu, touted by authorities as an alternative to Waze, is drawing ridicule over its shortcomings, with memes already suggesting it’s so poor that users may need a flying car to get around.

general.title: SAP CFO Says Cloud Growth at 25% Is 'Very Strong'
general.summary: SAP SE Chief Financial Officer Dominik Asam discusses the Germany-based company's performance as it reported higher growth for its cloud products than anticipated. "The core here is the conviction of our customers that SAP is an ingredient, a core ingredient, in the AI transformation journey," he tells Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Japan Scrambles to Patch PHP Flaws as Banks, Airlines Go Offline
general.summary: Japanese companies from banks to airlines took down digital services to shield themselves from flaws in internet software, one of the starkest examples of the chaos wrought by the discovery of vulnerabilities in the commonly used PHP programming language.
